items.caption: A modern vector redraw of 京 in an oracle-bone script style. The form has a broad roof-like top, a central opening, and long lower strokes; this shape is consistent with interpretations of 京 as a tall building, though it does not establish the graph’s original meaning.
items.alt: Black oracle-bone-style 京 form with a broad, peaked top, a central opening, and two long downward strokes.
items.selection_reason: This is the only verified, reusable candidate identified as 京 in an early script style. It illustrates the graph relevant to the building interpretation while remaining clearly labeled as a modern redraw.

limitations.text: This modern redraw is not a photograph or facsimile of a dated Shang inscription, so it cannot establish the form’s date or the historical meaning of its visible parts. The building interpretation is supported by paleographic descriptions, but the route from an early meaning to ‘capital’ remains uncertain.
